description: Fetch a Quora question page: metadata (title, topics, answer count) plus a list of answer preview cards. Answers are returned as excerpts with author, credential, publish date, upvote/comment counts, and URL. Use --include-related true to also return the 'All related' question list. A logged-in Quora session is recommended.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Question page URL (https://www.quora.com/<slug>) or just the slug, e.g. 'How-do-I-write-a-diary-entry-from-a-characters-point-of-view'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of answer cards to return (1-100, default 20). The answer list lazy-loads on scroll.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Answer ordering: recommended (Quora's default ranking) or recent (newest first).

parameters.name: include_related
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the 'All related' section with merged/related questions. Default false.
